Parsing hicpro files (matrix & bed)

Source: R/parse-hicpro.R
parse-hicpro.Rd

These functions are the workhorse internal functions used to import HiC-Pro .matrix and .bed files as GInteractions (wrapped into a HiCExperiment object by HiCExperiment() function).

Usage

.hicpro2gi(file, bed)

.getHicproAnchors(bed)

.hicpro2seqinfo(bed)

.dumpHicpro(file, bed)

Arguments

file

path to a matrix file from HiC-Pro

bed

path to the regions file generated by HiC-Pro

Value

a GInteractions object
